test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A hollow cylindrical tube made of plastic is 3 cm thick. If the external diameter is 20 cm and length of the tube is 49 cm, find the volume of the plastic.
solution:
**Given:**

External radius (R) = External diameter / 2 = 20 cm / 2 = 10 cm

Thickness (t) = 3 cm

Internal radius (r) = External radius - Thickness = 10 cm - 3 cm = 7 cm

Length (h) = 49 cm

**Formula used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ab59f6bd899e54e6e61ee74c8a0c1cb2c0fea186e2124da918080c68869cad6.png] 

Volume of cylindrical tube = πh(R² - r²)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Volume = π × 49 × (10² - 7²)

⇒ Volume = π × 49 × (100 - 49)

⇒ Volume = π × 49 × 51

⇒ Volume = (22)/(7) × 49 × 51

⇒ Volume = 7854 cm³

**Hence, the volume of the plastic is 7854 cm³.**
